selection: Lowest pooled RMSE under illustrative weather stress on five reused selection windows
weather_stress: Three seeded scenarios per origin; shared daily plus hourly errors. Day-one scales: temperature 2 C, wind 1 m/s, cloud .25, pressure 2 mmHg, humidity 5 percentage points. Day-two scales multiplied by 1.5. Daylight unchanged; density adjusted for temperature/pressure.
caveats: Stress assumptions are illustrative, not measured forecast uncertainty.
Observed-weather validation is optimistic for weather models.
Selection windows were reused after earlier model comparisons; selection optimism is possible.
The last window was already seen; it is an audit, not an untouched test.
Three stress scenarios do not create three independent historical windows.
Empirical nominal 95% intervals do not guarantee future coverage.
